summary: Russian forces have liberated Pisarevka in Sumy region and Nezhenka in Zaporozhye region according to the Russian Ministry of Defense, marking significant territorial gains. Ukraine conducted drone attacks on Russian commercial and energy infrastructure, including a fire at a Wildberries warehouse in Tambov (100,000 sq.m) and strikes on the Kstovsky oil refinery. The Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant reported two employees injured from a Ukrainian drone attack near hydraulic structures.
key_points: Russian Armed Forces liberated Pisarevka in Sumy region and Nezhenka in Zaporozhye region, confirmed by Russian Ministry of Defense. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32762)
A Wildberries facility in Tambov Oblast was attacked by drones with at least 16 shot down, causing a fire on 100,000 sq.m; operations suspended. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
Two employees of the Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant were injured from a targeted Ukrainian drone attack near the station's hydraulic structures. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
In Belgorod region, one civilian was killed and at least 13 injured from multiple drone attacks across Grayvoron, Valuyevsky, Borisovsky and other districts. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
The "Sever" group repelled a counterattack by two assault groups from the 68th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade of Ukrainian Armed Forces near Sadki in Sumy direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
Ukraine struck a large trading center area in Donetsk; three civilians including a child were wounded, according to Pushilin. (Source: @tass_agency/392154)
In Ternopil, people blocked and damaged a TCC vehicle attempting to forcibly mobilize a man, with police launching an investigation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32775)
MSC, a leading container shipping operator, suspended operations through Novorossiysk following a drone attack on the MSC Ulsan III vessel. (Source: @tass_agency/392160)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces have made territorial gains in Sumy and Zaporozhye regions with the liberation of Pisarevka and Nezhenka. Ukraine responded with significant drone strikes against Russian commercial infrastructure, including a major fire at a Wildberries warehouse in Tambov. Cross-border attacks continue on both sides with civilian casualties reported in Belgorod and Donetsk regions, while Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant staff were injured in a drone strike.

points: Ukrainian Armed Forces struck a large trading center area in Donetsk city, wounding three civilians including a child, according to statements by Pushilin and TASS correspondents. The strike drew condemnation from Russia's representative Miroshnik, who characterized it as an intentional targeting of civilians. (Source: @tass_agency/392142, @tass_agency/392154)

Ukraine conducted drone attacks on Wildberries facilities in Tambov Oblast with at least 16 drones intercepted, causing a fire affecting 100,000 square meters; operations were suspended at the facility. Kstovsky oil refinery in Nizhny Novgorod Oblast was also attacked, one of Russia's largest refineries previously targeted by Ukrainian forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755, @UkraineNow/83691)

In the northern Kharkov region, a Latvian citizen Vitaly Shampinsh was killed while fighting in Ukrainian Armed Forces ranks, marking the fourth Latvian mercenary eliminated by Russian forces since February 2022. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32759)

The FSB recruited a 63-year-old pensioner from occupied Luhansk region to assassinate a defense enterprise official on Kyiv Oblast using explosives placed under a car seat; the perpetrator was detained in Poland while attempting to transit to Russia via Belarus. (Source: @UkraineNow/83701)
Zelensky awarded Rada Speaker Stefanchuk the diplomatic rank of Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary, granting him diplomatic immunity. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32768)

Guided aviation bombs were launched by enemy tactical aviation targeting the Dnepropetrovsk region. Evening strikes on Peschanovka in the region resulted in observed secondary detonations. (Source: @kpszsu/74630, @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Ternopil, civilians blocked and damaged a TCC vehicle attempting to forcibly mobilize a man, slashing tires and breaking windows; police launched an investigation and the regional TCC called on citizens to refrain from aggression. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32775)

Russian Ministry of Defense reported the liberation of Pisarevka in Sumy region and Nezhenka in Zaporozhye region. The "Tsentr" group also took the village of Annovka near Dobropol. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32762, @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
The "Vostok" group penetrated enemy defenses near Zarnitsa and is expanding control near Dolinka in eastern Zaporozhye region along a wide front. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

The "Sever" group repelled a counterattack by two assault groups from the 68th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade of Ukrainian Armed Forces near Sadki, forcing enemy retreat to initial positions. Heavy fighting continues near Pisarevka with firefights reported near Ulanovo in Shostka district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Belgorod region, one civilian was killed and at least 13 injured across multiple districts. A woman died from drone detonation in Gora-Podol, Grayvoron district; another woman was seriously injured when an FPV drone struck her car in Pristen, Valuyevsky district. Multiple buildings and vehicles damaged. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Bryansk region, a kamikaze drone hit a residential building in Demyanki, Starodubsky district, killing the owner and injuring a local resident. A man was injured by drone explosion in Sopychi, Pogarsky district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Ten drones heading towards Moscow were destroyed. In Crimea, UAVs were again used against energy infrastructure targets. A child and adult died in Lipetsk Oblast when a UAV crashed into a private house. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

The "Sever" group reports Ukrainian forces are regrouping and transferring new reserves in the Kharkov direction, with fighting in Kazachya Lopana and heavy combat in Vasilevka area on the Volchansk section. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Russian Armed Forces are conducting heavy offensive battles in the direction of Nikanorovka from the Slavyansk direction, with continued pressure on Ukrainian defensive positions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

DeepState reports the most active combat around Kostyantynivka, which Russian forces are attempting to capture through active infiltration into the city, with Ukrainian forces conducting constant clearance operations. After capturing Illinivka, Russian forces are expanding control westward to enlarge the encirclement around the city. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23779)

Chasiv Yar is in greatest danger as Russian forces surround the city with their surrounding control, though Ukrainian forces are managing to hold positions inside the city; however, if flanks fall, the garrison will face significant challenges. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23779)

Two settlements of strategic interest to Russian forces for advancing toward Slovyansk are Raigorodok and Mykolaivka; while Raigorodok is firmly held, concerning infiltration has been observed in Mykolaivka as Russian forces probe for weaknesses. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23779)

In Donetsk city, Ukrainian forces struck a major trading center district, wounding three civilians including a child according to Pushilin and confirmed by TASS. Miroshnik characterized the strike as an intentional strategy of killing civilians. (Source: @tass_agency/392142, @tass_agency/392154, @tass_agency/392153)

Russian Armed Forces have liberated Pisarevka in the Sumy region according to Russian Ministry of Defense reports, marking a significant territorial gain in the northern sector. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32762)

The "Sever" group repelled a counterattack by two assault groups from the 68th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade near Sadki, forcing Ukrainian forces to retreat to their initial positions. Heavy fighting continues in the Pisarevka area. (Source: @ukr_leails_eng/32755)
In Shostka district, Russian assault units are engaged in firefights near Ulanovo as operations continue along the northern front. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Bryansk region, a kamikaze drone struck a residential building in the village of Demyanki, Starodubsky district, killing the owner and injuring a local resident. In Sopychi, Pogarsky district, a man was injured by drone explosion. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Reconnaissance drones from Chernihiv region were detected heading toward Kyiv and Brovary areas, indicating ongoing aerial reconnaissance activity along the northern approach to the capital. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71024, @mon1tor_ua/71023)
Fires were reported in Chernihiv and Kyiv regions following Russian strikes, with secondary detonations observed in Chernihiv region after strikes. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Russian Armed Forces launched strikes against targets in Odessa and Zaporozhye regions. In Zaporozhye region, the "Vostok" group has penetrated enemy defenses near Zarnitsa and is expanding control near Dolinka, which was captured the previous day. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)
Two employees of the Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant were injured from a targeted Ukrainian drone attack occurring in the area of the station's hydraulic structures. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Kherson region, besides constant drone strikes, Ukrainian forces are scattering mines from drones that may resemble wooden objects but contain detonators triggered by approaching vehicles, motorcycles, or persons with metal objects. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Reactive drones were launched from the Black Sea aquatory heading south toward Odesa region, specifically toward Tatarbunary. Multiple reactive drone groups were also detected from Kirovohrad region. (Source: @eRadarrua/107253, @kpszsu/74600)

One reactive Shahed was detected flying past Smila toward Kyiv Oblast, Obukhiv district, with another entering Smila itself. Additional reactive drones approached from Cherkasy region toward Bohuslav and Myronivka. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71051, @kpszsu/74634)

At least 16 drones attacked the Wildberries facility in Tambov Oblast during the night, causing a fire affecting 100,000 square meters; operations were suspended. Ten drones heading toward Moscow were destroyed by air defenses. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755, @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

In Crimea, UAVs were used again against energy infrastructure targets. A UAV crashed into a private house in Lipetsk Oblast, killing a child and an adult and injuring two people. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Guided aviation bombs were launched by enemy tactical aviation targeting the Dnepropetrovsk region, with evening strikes on Peschanovka producing secondary detonations. (Source: @kpszsu/74630, @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

Reactive Shahed drones were detected from multiple regions: Vinnytsia heading toward Khmelnychchyna, Kamianets-Podilskyi district; from Kirovohrad toward Kropyvnytskyi and Znamyanka; from Mykolaiv region toward Novyi Buh and Kirovohrad. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71057, @kpszsu/74627, @kpszsu/74639, @kpszsu/74624)

Reconnaissance drones from Chernihiv region continue targeting Kyiv and Brovary, while in Odesa region threats persist from both sea-launched drones and Shahed-type vehicles approaching from multiple vectors. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71024, @mon1tor_ua/71023, @kpszsu/74600)

According to monitoring data, reactive Shaheds are harder to intercept due to higher speed and altitude compared to standard Shaheds: reactive Shahed speed is significantly higher with flight altitude substantially above the 200-600 meters of standard variants. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71054)
Night was reported without a massive combined strike, though ballistic threat level for the capital remains stably at medium-high level. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/71028)

Two Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant employees injured from Ukrainian drone attack near hydraulic structures, raising concerns about nuclear safety. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32755)

sections.threat_assessment: The Zaporozhye Nuclear Power Plant faces elevated risk following the injury of two employees in a targeted drone attack near critical hydraulic infrastructure, suggesting Ukrainian intent to degrade plant operations. Russian territorial gains in Sumy and Zaporozhye regions indicate accelerated offensive operations along multiple axes. The Belgorod and Bryansk border regions experience persistent drone threats with civilian casualties mounting, demonstrating Ukrainian capability to sustain cross-border strikes. Drone attacks on Russian commercial infrastructure (Wildberries) and energy facilities (Kstovsky refinery) suggest Ukraine is expanding strike targets beyond military objectives. The infiltration pattern around Kostyantynivka and Chasiv Yar indicates Russian forces are successfully probing Ukrainian defenses for weaknesses.
sections.regional_response: Russian military command is repositioning reserves to the Kharkov direction according to "Sever" group reports, indicating anticipation of intensified operations. Ukraine's strike on the Wildberries facility in Tambov represents a significant escalation in targeting Russian commercial/logistics infrastructure, potentially affecting domestic supply chains. The detention of an FSB-recruited assassin in Poland while transiting to Russia demonstrates continued Russian hybrid operations against Ukrainian defense officials. MSC's suspension of Novorossiysk operations signals that maritime commerce is increasingly affected by the conflict, with implications for regional trade flows.
sections.intelligence_notes: A Latvian fighter (Vitaly Shampinsh) was eliminated in Kharkov region, marking the fourth Latvian mercenary killed since February 2022, suggesting continued foreign volunteer presence in Ukrainian forces. The "Sever" group's repelling of two assault groups from the 68th Separate Motor Rifle Brigade near Sadki indicates Ukrainian forces are conducting active counterattacks despite territorial losses. Ternopil residents' violent resistance against a territorial recruitment center (TCC) with slashed tires and broken windows reveals mounting social tension over forced mobilization in Ukraine. The use of "joink" mines resembling wooden objects in Kherson region represents an evolution in Ukrainian drone-delivered munitions designed to target vehicles and personnel with metal objects.
